llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The OpenTelemetry Collector's validation system uses a reflection-based approach where all component configs implement a Validate() error method. The requested change requires updating the core Validator interface in confmap/xconfmap/config.go to use ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error and threading context through all validation logic. This impacts every component config across both the core and contrib repositories, plus generated tests and documentation.

FILES:
- opentelemetry-collector/confmap/xconfmap/config.go — Core interface definition and reflection-based validation logic that must be updated to support context
- opentelemetry-collector/confmap/xconfmap/config_test.go — Test types implementing Validate() that must be migrated to ValidateWithContext
- opentelemetry-collector/component/config.go — Config type alias with documentation referencing Validator interface
- opentelemetry-collector/component/component.go — Factory interface documentation that references validation
- opentelemetry-collector/component/componenttest/configtest.go — Config validation helper with Validator documentation
- opentelemetry-collector/processor/batchprocessor/config.go — Component config implementing Validate() error
